title: Smart Farm | Node 01
description: ESP32 Smart Farm monitoring for site_01 / zone_A / node_01. InfluxDB datasetAi, sensor_data.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Latest DHT22 temperature. Celsius, display range 0 to 50 C.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "datasetAi")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data" and r._field == "temperature" and r.site == "site_01" and r.zone == "zone_A" and r.device == "node_01")
  |> last()

panels.title: Relative humidity
panels.description: Latest DHT22 relative humidity. Display range 0 to 100 percent.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "datasetAi")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data" and r._field == "humidity" and r.site == "site_01" and r.zone == "zone_A" and r.device == "node_01")
  |> last()

panels.title: Pump state
panels.description: Latest telemetry field pump. Value 1 means ON; 0 means OFF.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "datasetAi")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data" and r._field == "pump" and r.site == "site_01" and r.zone == "zone_A" and r.device == "node_01")
  |> last()

panels.title: Valve state
panels.description: Latest telemetry field valve. Value 1 means ON; 0 means OFF.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "datasetAi")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data" and r._field == "valve" and r.site == "site_01" and r.zone == "zone_A" and r.device == "node_01")
  |> last()

panels.title: Temperature history (C)
panels.description: Mean temperature over each interval in the selected time range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "datasetAi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data" and r._field == "temperature" and r.site == "site_01" and r.zone == "zone_A" and r.device == "node_01")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Humidity history (%)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "datasetAi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data" and r._field == "humidity" and r.site == "site_01" and r.zone == "zone_A" and r.device == "node_01")

panels.title: Pump history
panels.description: Pump telemetry history. Value 1 means ON; 0 means OFF.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "datasetAi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data" and r._field == "pump" and r.site == "site_01" and r.zone == "zone_A" and r.device == "node_01")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Valve history
panels.description: Valve telemetry history. Value 1 means ON; 0 means OFF.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "datasetAi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data" and r._field == "valve" and r.site == "site_01" and r.zone == "zone_A" and r.device == "node_01")

panels.title: Latest sensor records
panels.description: Latest telemetry rows for this node. Empty results mean no records in the selected time range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "datasetAi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data" and (r._field == "temperature" or r._field == "humidity" or r._field == "pump" or r._field == "valve") and r.site == "site_01" and r.zone == "zone_A" and r.device == "node_01")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "site", "zone", "device"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "site", "zone", "device", "temperature", "humidity", "pump", "valve"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)

panels.title: About this dashboard
panels.description: ESP32 Smart Farm | Site 01 / Zone A / Node 01`n`n- Temperature and humidity: DHT22 latest values and historical trends.`n- Pump and valve: telemetry state, where 1 = ON and 0 = OFF.`n- Source: measurement sensor_data, bucket datasetAi, organization Server-stack.`n- Auto refresh every 10 seconds; default time range is six hours.`n- Empty panels mean telemetry is not available for this node in the selected range.`n`nTelemetry state does not verify the electrical state of a physical load.
